instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Crest Capital manages a high-volume conference center and multiple satellite event spaces, catering to 500+ corporate events and weddings annually. The company operates in a complex matrix structure across various geographies, requiring sophisticated logistical coordination for dining, venue setup, and guest experience. They are currently seeking integrated end-to-end software solutions to streamline these manual operations.
answers.pastInitiatives: The previous attempt at weekly brainstorming sessions failed due to a lack of clear project ownership and defined ROI metrics; ideas were generated but never moved past the conceptual stage. This indicates a critical gap between ideation and practical implementation, suggesting that the informal process needs significant structural intervention.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary objective is to reduce operating expenses by 15% over the next two years while maintaining current output levels. We believe there is significant waste in our manual processes and want to identify the highest-ROI automation opportunities across order processing, invoicing, and customer support workflows. We are not looking to grow headcount—we want to do more with our existing team.
answers.additionalContext: Despite low direct competitive pressure in certain niche areas, the broader hospitality sector is rapidly adopting AI and SaaS tools for operational automation, creating an urgency to modernize internal processes. The current reliance on disparate legacy systems hinders holistic efficiency gains.
answers.teamSize: We have a corporate innovation division with 50+ staff spanning research scientists, engineers, designers, and strategy professionals. The division manages a portfolio of 15 active innovation projects at various maturity stages, from early-stage research collaborations with universities to near-commercialization products. Annual innovation budget is managed through a formal portfolio governance process with stage-gate funding decisions.

opportunities.title: Workflow Automation in Order Processing (CRM/Invoicing)
opportunities.rationale: Implementing low-risk automation in order management and invoicing can immediately streamline administrative tasks, directly addressing the efficiency goal without massive capital expenditure. This leverages existing digital maturity by connecting siloed systems.

first_actions: Audit current order lifecycle bottlenecks across all 3 spaces
Pilot integration of a low-code CRM module for automated invoicing
resources_needed: Subscription fees for mid-tier efficiency software
execution_plan.success_metric: 30% reduction in manual order processing time within Q2.
milestones: Q1: System audit and vendor selection
Q2: Pilot launch and workflow stabilization

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Dynamic Resource Allocation for Catering
opportunities.rationale: By deploying a sophisticated ML model to analyze historical event data and real-time inventory, we can radically optimize ingredient purchasing and staffing schedules. This moves beyond simple automation into predictive optimization, offering potential cost savings exceeding 15% by minimizing waste.

first_actions: Develop proof-of-concept model using existing event data sets
resources_needed: Cloud computing infrastructure for ML processing
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 10% reduction in food waste costs within the first year.
milestones: Q1: Data pipeline setup and model training baseline
Q3: Full integration into procurement/menu planning system

next_steps.action: Establish a structured, cross-functional 'Efficiency Task Force' with mandated KPIs.
Select and procure the vendor for low-code workflow automation pilot.

key_weaknesses: Highly informal innovation process leading to idea abandonment.
Low digital maturity (Level 2) hindering scalable software adoption.
Over-reliance on manual operations which increases operational risk and waste.
Lack of standardized metrics for success, making ROI justification difficult.
